recommendation.disclaimer: [NEEDS_REVIEW] This recommendation follows the study protocol. The treating physician makes the clinical decision.

rationale.DE_NOVO_IRF: New intraretinal fluid — shorten the interval.
rationale.IRF_INCREASE: Intraretinal fluid rose by {value} nL (threshold {threshold} nL) — shorten the interval.
rationale.IRF_DECREASE_INSUFFICIENT: Intraretinal fluid fell by less than half since the previous visit — shorten the interval.
rationale.DE_NOVO_CENTRAL_SRF: New central subretinal fluid (1 mm) — shorten the interval.
rationale.CENTRAL_SRF_INCREASE: Central subretinal fluid rose by {value} nL (threshold {threshold} nL) — shorten the interval.
rationale.SRF_RING_1_3_INCREASE: Subretinal fluid in the 1–3 mm ring rose by {value} nL — shorten the interval.
rationale.NEW_HEMORRHAGE: New retinal haemorrhage — shorten the interval.
rationale.BCVA_LOSS_5_LETTERS: Loss of 5 or more letters, attributed to nAMD — shorten the interval.
rationale.RESIDUAL_IRF_HALVED: Intraretinal fluid down by at least half but still present — keep the interval.
rationale.RESIDUAL_IRF_STABLE: Residual intraretinal fluid is stable — keep the interval.
rationale.CENTRAL_SRF_IMPROVING: Central subretinal fluid stable or falling but still present — keep the interval.
rationale.ACTIVITY_IMPROVING: Overall activity is falling — keep the interval.
rationale.DRY_STABLE: Dry and stable — extend the interval.

triggers.IRF_INCREASE: Intraretinal fluid +{value} nL, above the {threshold} nL threshold
triggers.IRF_DECREASE_INSUFFICIENT: Intraretinal fluid fell by less than half
triggers.CENTRAL_SRF_INCREASE: Central subretinal fluid +{value} nL, above the {threshold} nL threshold
triggers.SRF_RING_1_3_INCREASE: Subretinal fluid +{value} nL in the 1–3 mm ring
triggers.BCVA_LOSS_5_LETTERS: Lost 5 or more letters, attributed to nAMD
triggers.RESIDUAL_IRF_HALVED: Intraretinal fluid halved but still present
triggers.CENTRAL_SRF_IMPROVING: Central subretinal fluid stable or falling
triggers.NO_HEMORRHAGE_OR_BCVA_LOSS: No haemorrhage and no attributed vision loss
triggers.SRF_ISOLATED_1_3_STABLE: Isolated 1–3 mm ring fluid is stable
